coaching.title: Coaching
coaching.invitationsSubtitle: Coaches who want to train you.
coaching.noAthletes: No athletes yet. Invite someone by their email.
coaching.inviteHint: Invite by email. If they already use powerlog they get a notification; otherwise they get an email to sign up and you'll be linked automatically.
coaching.becomeBody: Train other athletes: build their plans, templates and mesocycles, and follow their progress.
coaching.noteSubtitle: Only you can see this note about the athlete.
coaching.planSessionSubtitle: Put a session on their calendar. You build the plan, they log the real sets.
coaching.planNotesPlaceholder: Focus, cues, anything they should know…
coaching.assignBlockSubtitle: Copy one of your mesocycles to them. Yours stays in your library.
coaching.noBlocksYet: You have no mesocycles yet. Build one and you can hand it to any athlete.
coaching.removeAthleteBody: You will lose access to @{athlete}’s training and to everything you planned for them. They keep it all.
coaching.leaveCoachBody: @{coach} will no longer see your training or plan for you. You keep everything they planned.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Log in to keep the streak alive.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Free forever for solo lifters.
register.optional: Optional · you can fill these later
register.invitedBanner: @{coach} invited you. Sign up with this email and you'll be linked automatically.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we’ll send a reset link.
forgot.sentSubtitle: If an account exists for that email, we’ve sent a reset link.
forgot.sentBody: Didn’t get it? Check spam, or try again in a minute.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.subtitle: Choose a new password for your account.
reset.invalidSubtitle: This page needs a reset token from your email link.
reset.invalidBody: The link looks incomplete or expired.
reset.doneSubtitle: You can now log in with your new password.

verify.successBody: Your email is confirmed. You’re all set.
verify.missingBody: This page needs a verification token from your email link.
verify.errorBody: The link may have expired or already been used. Request a new one from your profile.

dashboard.strengthEmpty: Log a few sets and your estimated 1RMs for the big three will show up here.
dashboard.noSessions: No sessions yet — your history will build here.
dashboard.toStart: to start sessions in a tap.

workouts.title: Workouts
workouts.noSessionsInRangeBody: There are no sessions in the selected period. Move to another week or widen the range.
workouts.templatePrefill: The session will be pre-filled with this template’s exercises and programmed sets.
workouts.blankSession: Leave empty to start a blank session.
workouts.noExercises: No exercises logged in this session.
workouts.historyError: Couldn’t load your history. Try refreshing.
workouts.noMatchingBody: No sessions match these filters. Try widening the date range or clearing them.
workouts.noSessionsBody: Start a session, add your lifts and log every set — your history, e1RM and PRs build from here.
workouts.deleteBody: This permanently removes the session and all its exercises and sets. This can’t be undone.
workouts.noExercisesYet: No exercises yet. Add one to start logging sets.

mesocycles.title: Mesocycles
mesocycles.name: Name
mesocycles.emptyBody: Plan a multi-week block: weeks, days and programmed sets, then generate its sessions.
mesocycles.deleteBody: “{name}” and its plan will be deleted. Sessions already generated are kept.
mesocycles.setStartDateHint: Set a start date (edit the plan) to generate weeks into dated sessions.
mesocycles.coachManaged: Your coach manages this block. You train what it generates.
mesocycles.planningForAthlete: You are planning this block for your athlete.

templates.emptyBody: Build a reusable session — pick your exercises and program sets once, then start a session from it in a tap.
templates.deleteBody: “{name}” will be permanently removed. Sessions already created from it are not affected.
templates.chooseSubtitle: Start a session pre-filled from one of your templates.
templates.name: Name

stats.title: Analytics
stats.intro: Strength, volume and balance from your logged sets. Estimated 1RM uses the Epley formula.
stats.emptyBody: No logged sets in this range. Log some sets and your dashboard fills in here.
stats.progressionSubtitle: Best e1RM per session, with a linear trend and 4/8/12-week projection.
stats.noE1rm: No e1RM data for this exercise in range.
stats.needTwo: Need at least two sessions to project a trend.
stats.weeklyVolumeSubtitle: Tonnage per week (Σ weight·reps over logged sets).
stats.intensityRpeSubtitle: Sets by RPE — hard work (≥8) glows ember.
stats.intensityRirSubtitle: Sets by reps in reserve — close to failure (≤2) glows ember.
stats.deltaSubtitle: Δ compares e1RM with the previous period.
stats.noLogged: No logged sets in this range.

profile.heading: Settings
profile.title: Your profile
profile.intro: This shapes how analytics and coaching read your training. Everything here is optional except your display name.
profile.loadError: Couldn’t load your profile. Try refreshing.
profile.avatarHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP · up to 5 MB.
profile.removeAvatarBody: Your profile picture will revert to your initials.
profile.readError: Could not read that image. Try another file.
profile.changePasswordBody: Update your password. You’ll stay signed in on this device.
profile.setPasswordBody: Your account signs in with Google. Set a password to also log in with email.
profile.verifyEmailBody: We sent a link to {email}. Click it to verify. Didn’t get it?
profile.verificationSent: Verification email sent. Check your inbox.
profile.sessionsBody: Devices where you’re signed in. Revoke any you don’t recognise.
profile.deleteBody: Permanently deletes your account and erases your personal data.

admin.nameEsHint: Shown to Spanish users; leave blank for the English name.
admin.slugImmutable: The slug is a stable key and cannot be changed.
admin.slugOptional: Optional — derived from the name if left blank.
admin.deleteExerciseBody: This removes it from the catalog. Exercises used in logged workouts cannot be deleted.
admin.cantDisableSelf: You can't disable your own account
admin.cantRevokeSelf: You can't revoke your own admin
admin.disableBody: {who} will be signed out and unable to log in until re-enabled.
admin.enableBody: {who} will be able to log in again.

serverErrors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.

serverErrors.FORBIDDEN: You don’t have permission to do that.

serverErrors.CANNOT_DISABLE_SELF: You can’t disable your own account.

serverErrors.INVALID_AI_PROVIDER: That AI provider is not supported.
serverErrors.INVALID_API_KEY_FORMAT: That does not look like an API key.

serverErrors.INVALID_ENCRYPTED_SECRET: The stored key could not be read. Enter it again.
serverErrors.AI_ENCRYPTION_KEY_MISCONFIGURED: AI is not configured on this server.

ai.intro: Connect your own OpenAI or Anthropic key so powerlog can analyse your training. Requests run on your provider account, so the cost and the rate limits are the ones on your own plan.
ai.loadError: We could not load your AI settings.
ai.apiKeyHint: Stored encrypted. It is never shown again, and never leaves the server.
ai.modelHint: Fetched live from the provider with your key.
ai.modelsError: We could not reach the provider to list its models.
ai.removeKeyBody: powerlog will forget your {provider} key. Nothing is revoked on the provider side — do that from their dashboard if you want the key dead.

openai.name: OpenAI
openai.body: Use GPT models. Requests run on your own OpenAI account.
openai.getKey: Get a key in the OpenAI platform

anthropic.name: Anthropic
anthropic.body: Use Claude models. Requests run on your own Anthropic account.
anthropic.getKey: Get a key in the Claude Console

ai.defaultHint: The provider powerlog uses when both are connected.
ai.usageIntro: Estimated from the tokens you spent through powerlog and each model’s public prices. The remaining balance lives only in the provider console.
ai.usageEmpty: No AI usage yet — it shows up here after your first request.
ai.usageError: We could not load your usage.

aiPlan.title: Program with AI
aiPlan.body: Let your AI provider set the weight and reps for every set, from your recent sessions and the notes you wrote.
aiPlan.draftBody: A proposal for this session. Nothing is written until you accept it.
aiPlan.refineAria: Ask for a change to the plan
aiPlan.extraInfoHint: Anything the model should know. It outranks what your history suggests.
aiPlan.extraInfoPlaceholder: Shoulder is sore, keep pressing light…

aiMesocycle.title: Design the block with AI
aiMesocycle.body: Pick the weeks and the days you train, and let your AI provider design the training week. It loads the lifts it knows your numbers on.
aiMesocycle.draftBody: A proposed training week. Nothing is saved until you take it into the builder and create the mesocycle.
aiMesocycle.pickADay: Pick at least one training day.
aiMesocycle.promptHint: Preferences and constraints — priorities, equipment you lack, lifts to avoid.
aiMesocycle.promptPlaceholder: Squat focus. No hack squat machine. Keep bench twice a week…
aiMesocycle.refinePlaceholder: Swap the leg press for lunges…
aiMesocycle.refineAria: Ask for a change to the training week
aiMesocycle.refineHint: You can change the training, not the shape: to change the weeks or the days, generate again.
aiMesocycle.weekBody: Design this week with AI, on the days it already trains. It replaces the week; you can edit it after.
aiMesocycle.weekDraftBody: A proposed week. Use it to fill this week, then edit it like any other.
